Your skills to build and practice exercise: Investment Banker
SKILLS TO BUILD

Critical evaluation of AI-generated financial insights — AI tools can quickly process large amounts of financial data and suggest trends or valuations, but a human touch is needed to check if these insights make sense and fit the real-world situation.

Clear and persuasive communication of complex financial information — Even if AI helps with analysis, presenting detailed financial ideas simply and convincingly to clients or colleagues still requires strong human communication and understanding of your audience.
PRACTICE EXERCISE

A good exercise would be to find a recent public financial report for a well-known company (for example, on their investor relations website). You could then ask a free AI tool to summarize the report and identify key financial risks or opportunities. After reviewing the AI's output, you could write a short memo (about 300-400 words) explaining the company's financial health, critically assessing the AI's points, and adding your own thoughts on any significant concerns or upsides the AI might have missed.
YOU WILL HAVE

You will have a copy of the original financial report, the AI-generated summary, and your own critical memo that shows your analysis and communication skills. Your memo would highlight where the AI was helpful and where your human judgment added more value.
